content.text:
This is our interpretation of your question:

How much FY2026 EBITDA sits in deals with an off-track thesis lever, and which levers fail?

content.statement:
WITH __exposure AS (
  SELECT
    company AS ex_company,
    erp AS ex_erp,
    failing_levers AS ex_failing,
    group_accounts_behind AS ex_group_accounts,
    accounts_behind AS exf_accounts,
    ebitda_fy2026_inr AS exf_ebitda,
    ebitda_at_stake_fy2026_inr AS exf_ebitda_at_stake,
    off_track_levers AS exf_off_track,
    effective_pct AS exf_stake
  FROM WIPRO_FINANCE_360_APP.APP_DATA.V_ONTO_DEAL_EXPOSURE
)
SELECT
  ex_company AS company,
  MAX(exf_stake) AS effective_pct,
  SUM(exf_ebitda) AS ebitda_fy2026_inr,
  SUM(exf_ebitda_at_stake) AS ebitda_at_stake_fy2026_inr,
  SUM(SUM(exf_ebitda)) OVER () AS total_ebitda_off_thesis_inr,
  ex_failing AS failing_levers,
  ex_erp AS erp,
  ex_group_accounts AS group_accounts_behind,
  SUM(exf_accounts) AS accounts_behind
FROM __exposure
WHERE
  exf_off_track > 0
GROUP BY
  ex_company,
  ex_failing,
  ex_erp,
  ex_group_accounts
ORDER BY
  ebitda_fy2026_inr DESC
 -- Generated by Cortex Analyst (request_id: 38078667-58f6-43e9-a308-f01c5fa56653)
;
